title: Dal Tadka
description: Yellow lentils simmered until soft, finished with a sizzling tempering of ghee, cumin, garlic and dried red chilli. The everyday weeknight dal.
steps: Rinse the toor dal a couple of times, then add it to a pressure cooker with the turmeric, water and half the salt. Pressure cook for 4-5 whistles, until soft and mushy.
Once the pressure releases, whisk the dal lightly to loosen it to a pourable consistency, adding a little hot water if it's too thick.
For the tempering, heat ghee in a small pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle, then add the garlic and dried red chillies, frying until the garlic turns light golden.
Add the onion and cook until soft and lightly browned, then add the tomato and cook until it breaks down, about 4-5 minutes. Stir in the red chilli powder and remaining salt.
Pour this tempering over the cooked dal and simmer together for 5 minutes so the flavours combine. Garnish with coriander leaves before serving.
